description: Input -> expected output cases generated from the TypeScript redaction engine (packages/core/src/redact.ts) by `pnpm spec`. `redact` is redactText(input); `find` / `findCredentials` are the kinds findSensitive reports without / with credentials; `idempotent` says redact(redact(x)) == redact(x). `sanitize` cases check sanitizeBody (2048 UTF-16 units) and sanitizeSnapshot (204800); a long output is given as `outputDigest` (length in UTF-16 units and SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text). An `input` written as {repeat: [unit, times], prefix?, suffix?} stands for prefix + unit * times + suffix. Text that looks like a provider key (Slack, Stripe, AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, npm, PEM, JWT) is never stored literally, so secret scanners stay quiet: an `input`, `redact` or `output` written as {join: [part, ...]} stands for the parts concatenated. An implementation passes when every case matches.
